skill.desc.peerless_spear:
For 4 seconds, the spear lengthens and basic attacks pierce up to 3 enemies ahead.
Deals {atk.png} 130% damage to the main target and 60% to each enemy behind.
skill.desc.spell_echo:
Copies one ally's next skill
and repeats it at half its original effect.
skill.desc.prophetic_mirror:
Up to 2 allies each cast their next attack spell once more.
The copied spells strike at 80% power, based on your own ATK.
skill.desc.call_of_the_dead:
Summons 3 undead.
When recast, replaces up to 2 fallen summons.
skill.desc.legion_of_the_dead:
Summons 3 undead.
When recast, replaces up to 2 fallen summons.
skill.desc.bramble_prison:
Deals {atk.png} 120% damage to an enemy and traps it in a wooden cage.
The trapped enemy must break the cage with its attacks first.
skill.desc.elderwood_prison:
Deals {atk.png} 140% damage to up to 2 enemies and traps each in a wooden cage.
Trapped enemies must break their own cages with their attacks first.
skill.desc.dimensional_duel:
Slashes an enemy for {atk.png} 200% damage, then duels it alone in a rift in time for 2.5 seconds.
Gains {aspd.png} +50% for the duration.
skill.desc.temporal_assault:
Slashes an enemy for {atk.png} 240% damage, then fights it alongside 1 ally in a rift in time for 3 seconds.
Gains {aspd.png} +50% for the duration.
skill.desc.heavens_judgment:
Judges an enemy with light for {atk.png} 400% damage.
Judging the same enemy again in a row raises the damage to 550%, then 700%.
skill.desc.absolute_judgment:
Judges an enemy with light for {atk.png} 450% damage.
Judging the same enemy again in a row raises the damage to 650%, then 850%.
skill.desc.rupturing_descent:
Plunges down, dealing 180% {atk.png} damage to each of up to 3 enemies.
A shockwave bursts from each enemy hit, dealing 60% {atk.png} damage to the other enemies hit nearby.
skill.desc.doom_resonance:
Plunges down, dealing 200% {atk.png} damage to each of up to 4 enemies.
A shockwave bursts from each enemy hit, dealing 60% {atk.png} damage to the other enemies hit nearby.
skill.desc.lance_extension:
For 3 seconds, the spear lengthens and basic attacks pierce up to 2 enemies ahead.
Deals {atk.png} 130% damage to the main target and 60% to the enemy behind.
skill.desc.celestial_arsenal:
Draws a spear from a rift and fires it, dealing {atk.png} 200% damage.
For 5 seconds, when other allies use active skills, fires up to 3 extra spears.
skill.desc.rift_arsenal:
Draws a spear from a rift and fires it, dealing {atk.png} 180% damage.
For 4 seconds, when other allies use active skills, fires up to 2 extra spears.
skill.desc.eclipse_snipe:
Snipes the enemy with the lowest {hp.png}, dealing {atk.png} 300% damage.
Each kill snipes the next enemy, striking up to 3 enemies.
skill.desc.chain_snipe:
Snipes the enemy with the lowest {hp.png}, dealing {atk.png} 240% damage.
On a kill, snipes another enemy once more.
skill.desc.celestial_return:
Revives the first ally to fall at 60% of their max {hp.png}
and makes that ally's skill ready to use at once.
skill.desc.salvation_arrow: Revives the first ally to fall at 40% of their max {hp.png}.
skill.desc.grail_swordfall:
Drops giant swords of light in front of up to 3 allies, dealing
{atk.png} 70% damage to nearby enemies.
Each sword blocks one direct attack on its ally, then shatters,
dealing {atk.png} 50% damage to nearby enemies.
skill.desc.guardian_swordfall:
Drops swords of light in front of up to 2 allies, dealing
{atk.png} 60% damage to nearby enemies.
Each sword blocks one direct attack on its ally, then shatters,
dealing {atk.png} 40% damage to nearby enemies.
skill.desc.flash_barrage:
Every 7 basic attacks, teleports between enemies,
slashing up to 3 different enemies in turn before returning.
skill.desc.flash_slash:
Every 7 basic attacks, teleports to the farthest enemy,
deals {atk.png} 150% damage, and returns.
skill.desc.soul_severance:
Unleashes the power of twin scythes in every direction,
dealing {atk.png} 180% damage to up to 4 nearby enemies each.
skill.desc.reapers_dance:
Spreads twin scythes and slashes in every direction around itself,
dealing {atk.png} 160% damage to up to 3 nearby enemies each.
skill.desc.titans_gaze:
Fires a Shrink Ray,
dealing {atk.png} 140% damage to up to 2 enemies in front.
Enemies hit shrink for 3 seconds, dealing 35% less direct damage.
skill.desc.shrink_ray:
Fires a Shrink Ray,
dealing {atk.png} 140% damage.
The enemy hit shrinks for 3 seconds, dealing 30% less direct damage.
skill.desc.crescent_requital:
For 5 seconds, moonlight remembers 35% of the direct damage allies take.
When it ends, the remembered damage heals up to 3 allies,
and half of it strikes the enemy with the highest health.
skill.desc.moonlit_memory:
For 4 seconds, moonlight remembers 30% of the direct damage allies take.
When it ends, the remembered damage heals
up to 2 allies with the lowest health.
skill.desc.cataclysm_flurry:
Basic attacks have a 20% chance to unleash 5 magic thrusts in a row,
dealing a total of {atk.png} 280% damage.
skill.desc.nightmare_flurry:
Basic attacks have a 20% chance to unleash 3 magic thrusts in a row,
dealing a total of {atk.png} 200% damage.
skill.desc.soul_feast:
Fires skull bolts at up to 2 enemies, dealing {atk.png} 180% damage to each,
storing half the health taken in orbs.
The orbs heal allies at 70% health or lower.
skill.desc.life_siphon:
Fires a skull bolt that deals {atk.png} 160% damage,
storing half the health it takes in an orb.
The orb heals an ally at 70% health or lower.
skill.desc.arcane_unleashing:
Three beams that grow stronger deal a total of {atk.png} 660% damage over 3 seconds.
With few enemies, several beams focus on one enemy.
skill.desc.abyssal_ray:
Fires a beam that grows stronger for 3 seconds, dealing {atk.png} 480% damage in total.
If the target falls, the rest of the beam turns to another enemy.
skill.desc.spectral_return:
A wraith breaks out of his body and pierces up to 4 enemies,
dealing {atk.png} 100% damage to each,
then {atk.png} 80% to each again on its way back.
skill.desc.spectral_rush:
A wraith breaks out of his body and rushes through enemies,
dealing {atk.png} 130% damage to each of up to 3 before returning.
skill.desc.chain_spear:
Hurls a chained spear at the farthest enemy,
dealing {atk.png} 150% damage and dragging it in front of him.
skill.desc.execution_chain:
Hurls a chained spear at the farthest enemy,
dealing {atk.png} 180% damage and dragging it in front of him.
The enemy hit bleeds for 3 seconds.
skill.desc.devouring_arrow:
Fires a giant illusion arrow that deals {atk.png} 240% damage.
In flight it devours up to 3 enemy basic-attack projectiles and grows stronger.
skill.desc.hollow_arrow:
Fires a large illusion arrow that deals {atk.png} 170% damage.
In flight it swallows up to 2 enemy basic-attack projectiles and grows stronger.
skill.desc.twilight_barrage:
Unleashes a downpour of arrows that pushes enemies back;
each arrow deals {atk.png} 60% damage.
skill.desc.arrow_rain:
Drops a rain of black arrows one after another, pushing enemies back;
each arrow deals {atk.png} 70% damage.
skill.desc.ruin_tremor:
On a kill, stomps the ground, dealing {atk.png} 70% damage
to up to 3 nearby enemies and gaining a shield for 3 seconds.
skill.desc.arcane_collapse: Hurls a green orb at the farthest enemy. The orb pulls in up to 2 nearby enemies, then explodes, dealing {atk.png} 90% damage to each.
skill.desc.shadow_harvest:
Killing an enemy absorbs its shadow,
granting a shield equal to 15% of your max {hp.png} for 2 seconds.
skill.desc.spellblade_vortex:
Throws a spellblade at the farthest enemy.
The spinning blade damages the target and the enemy closest to it, pulling the second enemy toward the target.
skill.desc.glacial_shatter: Ice pillars deal {atk.png} 80% damage to each of up to 3 enemies in front and freeze them for 1.5 seconds. Shattering pillars deal an additional {atk.png} 70% damage to each.
skill.desc.frost_spike: Erupts ice spikes beneath up to 2 enemies in front, dealing {atk.png} 110% damage to each and freezing them for 1 second.
skill.desc.judgments_radiance: Raises a hammer to release a burst of light, dealing {atk.png} 180% damage to each of up to 2 nearby enemies and preventing skill use for 3 seconds.
skill.desc.condemning_strike: Slams an enemy with a radiant hammer, dealing {atk.png} 180% damage and preventing skill use for 2 seconds.
skill.desc.wings_of_victory: Each kill or 6 basic attack hits against bosses fills 1 wing segment. At 4 segments, grants all allies {aspd.png} +25% and {spd.png} +30% for 4 seconds.
skill.desc.victory_signal: Each kill or 6 basic attack hits against bosses fills 1 flag segment. At 4 segments, grants all allies {aspd.png} +15% for 4 seconds.
skill.desc.wild_stampede: Four wild horses race across the battlefield, dealing 160% {atk.png} damage to each of up to 4 enemies and knocking them back.
skill.desc.call_of_the_plains: Two wild horses charge across the battlefield, dealing 120% {atk.png} damage to each of up to 3 enemies in their path and knocking them back.
skill.desc.flame_descent: Summons 1 Flame Spirit. If it is already present, launches a giant fireball together with the spirit, dealing 110% {atk.png} damage to each of up to 3 enemies.
skill.desc.flame_call: Summons 1 Fire Spirit. If it is already present, the spirit unleashes a flame burst that deals 70% {atk.png} damage to each of up to 2 nearby enemies.
skill.desc.triple_tide: Unleashes waves that deal 110% {atk.png} damage to each of up to 3 enemies and knock them back. Restores 6% of maximum {hp.png} and removes a debuff from up to 2 allies the waves pass through.
skill.desc.cleansing_wave: Unleashes a wave that deals 110% {atk.png} damage to each of up to 2 enemies and knocks them back. Removes a debuff from 1 ally the wave passes through.

endless_tribe_deep_intro: Long hardened in the depths. As dark as they are tough.
endless_tribe_blood_intro: Drawn in by the smell of blood.
endless_tribe_frost_intro: They march in with the blizzard.
endless_tribe_ash_trait: This host: {hp.png} +6%, takes 40% less damage over time
endless_tribe_venom_intro: They carry the poison of the marsh.
endless_tribe_venom_trait: This host: {atk.png} +6%, allies it hits receive 30% less healing for 2 s
endless_tribe_shadow_trait: This host takes 20% less ranged and 10% more melee damage
endless_tribe_sand_intro: Carried in on the desert wind.
endless_elite_giant_desc: 1.5x size. 3x {hp.png} and 1.5x {atk.png}, but 30% lower {spd.png} and {aspd.png}. Cannot be knocked back.
endless_elite_regen_desc: After 2 s without being hit, restores 4% of max {hp.png} per second.
endless_elite_berserk_desc: At half {hp.png} or below: +60% {atk.png}, +40% {aspd.png}, and it grows.
endless_elite_splitter_desc: When defeated, splits into two small copies with 25% {hp.png} each.
endless_elite_wraith_desc: Ignores the first damage it takes.
endless_elite_statue_desc: Never loses more than 10% of its max {hp.png} to one hit. Very slow.
endless_elite_frost_desc: Allies it hits get 20% lower {aspd.png} for 2 s.
endless_elite_ember_desc: When defeated, explodes for its {atk.png} in damage to nearby allies.
endless_elite_vampire_desc: Restores {hp.png} equal to 30% of the damage it deals.
endless_elite_venom_desc: Poisons allies it hits for 3 s (20% of that hit per second).
endless_elite_mirror_desc: Reflects 20% of the ranged damage it takes.
endless_elite_charger_desc: Rushes in fast until first contact; its first attack deals 2x damage.
endless_gatekeeper_desc: From wave 100, every 50 waves the battlefield's last boss blocks the way with three traits and 1.5x {hp.png}.
endless_door_fate_both: A and B card goals complete

ach_absorb_six_desc: Have 1 unit absorb units of all 6 classes.
ach_jokers_2_desc: Own 2 Jesters at the same time.

ach_judge_clean_desc: Clear Normal or Hard, winning every Judgment wave without losing a unit.

ach_david_desc: Win a boss wave while owning just 1 Normal-grade unit.

ach_babylon_desc: Defeat the final boss on Hard with every unit from a different faction.
ach_no_rank2_desc: Clear Normal or Hard without raising any unit to 2 stars.
ach_loyal_desc: Clear a battlefield keeping 1 unit from the first wave until the end.
ach_no_assist_desc: Clear Normal or Hard without using a nudge or a blast.
ach_nudge_3lines_desc: Complete 3 or more winning lines with a single nudge.
ach_blast_4lines_desc: Complete 4 or more winning lines with a single blast.
ach_pure_faction_desc: Defeat the final boss on Hard with units of a single faction.
ach_eight_summons_desc: Summon 8 or more units in a single spin.
ach_codex_units_desc: Record 100% of the units in the Collection.
ach_codex_enemies_desc: Record 100% of the enemies in the Collection (Endless Mode excluded).
ach_codex_cores_desc: Record 100% of the cores in the Collection.
ach_codex_items_desc: Record 100% of the items in the Collection.
ach_runs_100_desc: Finish 100 runs, win or lose (restarts excluded).
ach_boss_100_desc: Defeat 100 bosses (campaign and Endless Mode combined).

upgrade_wingold_desc: Gain {gold.png} 5 more each time you win a wave.
upgrade_comebackgold2_desc: The {gold.png} gained after a defeat, if the run continues, becomes 150.
upgrade_shopdiscount_desc: Once per run, one shop item costs {essence.png} 1 less.
upgrade_lastspin_desc: The last spin of each wave costs {gold.png} 50 less.
upgrade_secondcoreuncommon_desc: The second core choices also guarantee 1 uncommon-or-higher core.

upgrade_stoneomen_desc: Omen Stone can now appear on the C card. Pick 1 of 3 candidates.
upgrade_stonemastery_desc: Mastery Stone can now appear on the B card. The unit arrives at 2-Star.
upgrade_stonerift_desc: Rift Stone can now appear on the B card. Normal, or Legendary / Prism!

upgrade_itemresearch_desc: Piercing Manual and Arcane Training can appear in the shop.

imprint.desc.pierce_1: Basic attacks pierce up to 1 additional target, dealing {atk.png} 25% damage.
imprint.desc.brace_1: After a basic attack, the next basic attack is empowered by {atk.png} +25%.
imprint.desc.volley_1: Every 3rd basic attack immediately strikes the same target again for {atk.png} 40% damage.
imprint.desc.blind_1: 16% chance on attack: blind target for 0.4s (attacks miss)
imprint.desc.transfer_1: On attack, 30% of the damage dealt spreads to 1 other nearby enemy.
imprint.desc.overdrive_1: After defeating an enemy, the next basic attack is empowered by {atk.png} +100%.
imprint.desc.bash_1: 18% chance on attack: stun target for 0.5s
imprint.desc.knockback_1: 18% chance on attack: slightly knock back target
imprint.desc.poison_1: 25% chance on attack: poison the target for 2s, dealing 1.2% of its max {hp.png} every 0.5s
imprint.desc.lifesteal_1: Recover 4% of dmg dealt as HP
imprint.desc.self_destruct_1: On death, explodes, dealing 60% of its max {hp.png} to each nearby enemy and stunning them for 1s.
imprint.desc.fear_1: Hits have a 15% chance to make the target flee in fear for 0.8s.
imprint.desc.chain_1: On hit, damage chains once to the nearest other enemy.
imprint.desc.shrink_1: On basic attack, has a 10% chance to shrink the enemy for 3 seconds. Shrunk enemies have {atk.png} -20%, and their {aspd.png} becomes slower than this unit's.
imprint.desc.enlarge_1: When hit: 15% chance to become Giant for 3s, gaining +30% max {hp.png} and +25% {atk.png}.
imprint.desc.execute_1: On hit, instantly kills enemies at 10% {hp.png} or less.
imprint.desc.earthquake_1: Attacks have a 12% chance to deal 100% {atk.png} damage to all enemies on the battlefield and stun them.
imprint.desc.meteor_1: Basic attacks have a 10% chance to call down a meteor, dealing 180% {atk.png} damage to each of up to 3 nearby enemies. Higher maximum {hp.png} increases the meteor size and blast radius.
imprint.desc.shadow_clone_1: Summon a clone (55% of this unit's {hp.png}, 70% of its {atk.png}) to fight alongside it for 8s. A new clone appears 2s after the last one is gone.
imprint.desc.soul_split_1: Basic attack hits pull the enemy's soul out of its body for 3s. Damage dealt to the soul is also dealt to the body.
imprint.desc.ruin_1: Presence: all enemies take 6% {atk.png} as DoT/sec
imprint.desc.colossus_descent_1: Summon a Colossus (200% of this unit's {hp.png}, 40% of this unit's {atk.png})
imprint.desc.overlord_1: Turn up to 2 slain enemies into followers. Boss followers stay only until the next boss fight.
imprint.desc.undying_soul_1: On death: remain in battle as a Soul (40% {atk.png})
imprint.desc.timeless_1: 8% chance on attack: stop time for 3s
random_option.effect.24: Every 10 enemies killed: basic attack damage +1%.
random_option.effect.30: Kills with an attack skill reduce its remaining cooldown by 15~35%. Once per cast.
random_option.effect.27: Basic attack damage +15~35% against debuffed enemies.
random_option.effect.26: Receives the effects of every class's basic training manuals you own, regardless of its own class.
random_option.effect.25: Basic attacks prioritize the attackable enemy with the lowest current {hp.png}.
random_option.effect.23: Every 2 nudges or blasts that create a new winning line grant {atk.png} +1%.
random_option.effect.05: Damage to the last remaining enemy: {atk.png} +12~24%
random_option.effect.07: On death: survive once for 1s at 1 {hp.png}
random_option.effect.12: When this unit is absorbed: Absorb LV +1~5
random_option.effect.15: Above 50% HP: {atk.png} +20%. At 50% HP or below: Damage Taken -20%
random_option.effect.16: On kill, restore 4~8% of max {hp.png}. Up to 3 times per battle
random_option.effect.17: If there are no other allies of the same class: {atk.png} +8~16%, damage taken -3~7%
random_option.effect.19: Prioritize enemies near the base and deal {atk.png} +15~35% damage to that enemy

core.desc.Resonoscope: When 3+ rows match the same symbol, next spin's jackpot chance +3%. (Once per wave.)
core.desc.Prosperfang: After 3 consecutive wins, units spawned on the next spin gain +10% stats.
core.desc.MirageGoblet: For 3 spins after a jackpot, the chance of the same symbol appearing consecutively +5%.

item.effect.09.1: The drum sounds on the first enemy kill. All allies' next basic attack deals 25% more damage. (Lv.1)
item.effect.09.2: The drum sounds on the first enemy kill. All allies' next basic attack deals 40% more damage. (Lv.2)
item.effect.09.3: The drum sounds on the first enemy kill. All allies' next basic attack deals 55% more damage. (Lv.3)
item.effect.09.4: The drum sounds on the first enemy kill. All allies' next basic attack deals 70% more damage. (Lv.4)
collection_enemy.Goblin.desc: A tiny body with plenty of nerve. This forest troublemaker comes in crowds and pokes at gaps in your defense.
collection_enemy.GoblinThief.desc: Light on its feet, lighter on manners. It closes in fast and lashes out with a short blade.
collection_enemy.Orc.desc: A forest bruiser that pushes against your line with sheer bulk. Slow, but hard to put down.
collection_enemy.Orc Axe Raider.desc: Why walk closer when an axe will do? This raider throws from behind the front line.
collection_enemy.Orc Veteran.desc: An orc that has survived countless fights. Tough and heavy-handed, it keeps hammering at your defenses.
collection_enemy.Orc Veteran.skill: Hits have a 10% chance to stun the target for 1 s.
collection_enemy.Charge Orc.desc: An orc that charges in without a second thought. Its thick hide and rough blows put pressure on the front line.
collection_enemy.Orc War Chief.desc: Bulk and brute force keep this chief in charge. Block one blow and the next is already on its way.
collection_enemy.Orc War Chief.trait: Follows a basic attack with a powerful strike dealing {atk.png} 160% damage.
collection_enemy.Wolf.desc: A swift wolf called by the Grimwolf Orc. More interested in biting soldiers than reaching the base.
collection_enemy.Wolf.trait: Summoned wolves deal no base damage, even if they get through.
collection_enemy.Goblin Rider.desc: A small rider and an impatient wolf make quite a team. They race up to your defensive line.
collection_enemy.Warg Orc.desc: A warg's speed with an orc's strength. Its blows land as hard as its charge.
collection_enemy.Grimwolf Orc.desc: A forest leader with wolves at its call. The longer the fight, the more teeth you have to face.
collection_enemy.Grimwolf Orc.skill: Summons 2 wolves every 5 s. Summoned wolves cannot damage the base.
collection_enemy.Howl Orc.desc: Roars and fists tear at your line. This savage leader attacks faster the longer you hold it off.
collection_enemy.Howl Orc.skill: Roars to deal {atk.png} 200% damage to up to 3 nearby allies and knock them back. Each roar increases {aspd.png}.
collection_enemy.Orc Berserker.desc: No plans to drop its axe or back down. Wild swings shake up a crowded front line.
collection_enemy.Orc Berserker.skill: Deals {atk.png} 80% damage to up to 2 nearby allies and knocks them back.
item.effect.37.1: After their first engagement, warriors take 10% less damage for 6s. (Lv.1)
item.effect.37.2: After their first engagement, warriors take 18% less damage for 6s. (Lv.2)
item.effect.37.3: After their first engagement, warriors take 26% less damage for 6s. (Lv.3)
item.effect.08.1: When an enemy dies with poison, bleed, or burn, 60% of its remaining damage over time transfers to one nearby enemy.
item.effect.08.2: When an enemy dies with poison, bleed, or burn, 80% of its remaining damage over time transfers to one nearby enemy.
item.effect.08.3: When an enemy dies with poison, bleed, or burn, 100% of its remaining damage over time transfers to one nearby enemy.
item.effect.08.4: When an enemy dies with poison, bleed, or burn, 120% of its remaining damage over time transfers to one nearby enemy.
item.effect.38.1: Archers gain +90% {aspd.png} for 3 seconds, then reload for 2 seconds. (Lv.1)
item.effect.38.2: Archers gain +120% {aspd.png} for 3 seconds, then reload for 2 seconds. (Lv.2)
item.effect.38.3: Archers gain +150% {aspd.png} for 3 seconds, then reload for 2 seconds. (Lv.3)
item.effect.15.1: Ranged allies cycle through enemies. Basic attacks deal 15% more damage when switching targets. (Lv.1)
item.effect.15.2: Ranged allies cycle through enemies. Basic attacks deal 25% more damage when switching targets. (Lv.2)
item.effect.15.3: Ranged allies cycle through enemies. Basic attacks deal 35% more damage when switching targets. (Lv.3)
item.effect.02.1: At battle start, all allies gain a shield equal to 8% of max {hp.png}. Lasts 5 seconds after the first hit. (Lv.1)
item.effect.02.2: At battle start, all allies gain a shield equal to 12% of max {hp.png}. Lasts 5 seconds after the first hit. (Lv.2)
item.effect.02.3: At battle start, all allies gain a shield equal to 16% of max {hp.png}. Lasts 5 seconds after the first hit. (Lv.3)
item.effect.02.4: At battle start, all allies gain a shield equal to 20% of max {hp.png}. Lasts 5 seconds after the first hit. (Lv.4)
item.effect.06.1: The ally placed furthest forward takes 10% less damage. (Lv.1)
item.effect.06.2: The ally placed furthest forward takes 15% less damage. (Lv.2)
item.effect.06.3: The ally placed furthest forward takes 20% less damage. (Lv.3)
item.effect.06.4: The ally placed furthest forward takes 25% less damage. (Lv.4)
item.effect.04.1: When an ally's shield breaks, one other ally with the lowest {hp.png} percentage gains a shield of 6% of max {hp.png}. (Lv.1)
item.effect.04.2: When an ally's shield breaks, one other ally with the lowest {hp.png} percentage gains a shield of 9% of max {hp.png}. (Lv.2)
item.effect.04.3: When an ally's shield breaks, one other ally with the lowest {hp.png} percentage gains a shield of 12% of max {hp.png}. (Lv.3)
item.effect.04.4: When an ally's shield breaks, one other ally with the lowest {hp.png} percentage gains a shield of 15% of max {hp.png}. (Lv.4)
item.effect.16.1: If you deploy 3 or fewer allies, each gains a shield equal to 20% of max {hp.png}. (Lv.1)
item.effect.16.2: If you deploy 3 or fewer allies, each gains a shield equal to 30% of max {hp.png}. (Lv.2)
item.effect.16.3: If you deploy 3 or fewer allies, each gains a shield equal to 40% of max {hp.png}. (Lv.3)
item.effect.17.1: On a kill, a ricochet stone flies at another enemy, dealing 50% of the excess damage. (Lv.1)
item.effect.17.2: On a kill, a ricochet stone flies at another enemy, dealing 80% of the excess damage. (Lv.2)
item.effect.17.3: On a kill, a ricochet stone flies at another enemy, dealing 100% of the excess damage. (Lv.3)
item.effect.07.1: Each battle, ranged allies completely block the first enemy ranged basic attack that hits them. (Lv.1)
item.effect.07.2: Each battle, ranged allies completely block the first 2 enemy ranged basic attacks that hit them. (Lv.2)
item.effect.07.3: Each battle, ranged allies completely block the first 3 enemy ranged basic attacks that hit them. (Lv.3)
item.effect.07.4: Each battle, ranged allies completely block the first 4 enemy ranged basic attacks that hit them. (Lv.4)
item.effect.14.1: The first ally to fall survives as a statue for 1.5s, then recovers 15% of max {hp.png}. (Lv.1)
item.effect.14.2: The first ally to fall survives as a statue for 2s, then recovers 22% of max {hp.png}. (Lv.2)
item.effect.14.3: The first ally to fall survives as a statue for 2.5s, then recovers 29% of max {hp.png}. (Lv.3)
item.effect.10.1: The first basic attack to hit each moving enemy roots them for 0.8s. (Lv.1)
item.effect.10.2: The first basic attack to hit each moving enemy roots them for 1.2s. (Lv.2)
item.effect.10.3: The first basic attack to hit each moving enemy roots them for 1.6s. (Lv.3)
item.effect.10.4: The first basic attack to hit each moving enemy roots them for 2s. (Lv.4)
item.effect.11.1: A spring rises in your camp. Allies standing in it recover 1.5% of max {hp.png} every second. (Lv.1)
item.effect.11.2: A spring rises in your camp. Allies standing in it recover 2.5% of max {hp.png} every second. (Lv.2)
item.effect.11.3: A spring rises in your camp. Allies standing in it recover 3.5% of max {hp.png} every second. (Lv.3)
item.effect.03.1: Once per battle, instantly heals the first ally to fall to 30% {hp.png} or less for 20% of max {hp.png}. (Lv.1)
item.effect.03.2: Once per battle, instantly heals the first ally to fall to 30% {hp.png} or less for 28% of max {hp.png}. (Lv.2)
item.effect.03.3: Once per battle, instantly heals the first ally to fall to 30% {hp.png} or less for 36% of max {hp.png}. (Lv.3)
item.effect.03.4: Once per battle, instantly heals the first ally to fall to 30% {hp.png} or less for 44% of max {hp.png}. (Lv.4)
item.effect.05.1: If a ranged basic attack's target dies while the projectile is in flight, it tracks another enemy and deals 20% bonus damage. (Lv.1)
item.effect.05.2: If a ranged basic attack's target dies while the projectile is in flight, it tracks another enemy and deals 35% bonus damage. (Lv.2)
item.effect.05.3: If a ranged basic attack's target dies while the projectile is in flight, it tracks another enemy and deals 50% bonus damage. (Lv.3)
item.effect.05.4: If a ranged basic attack's target dies while the projectile is in flight, it tracks another enemy and deals 65% bonus damage. (Lv.4)

core.desc.TwistedBell: If the first spin of each wave has no winning lines, reroll that spin once for free.
core.desc.Copycap: After a failed spin, if a reel's top and bottom symbols match, its middle symbol becomes that symbol.
core.desc.TwinCherries: If the first spin of a wave has no winning lines, the last reel copies the first reel's symbol arrangement.
core.desc.BanStamp: Choose a symbol currently on the slot machine. That symbol will not appear on the next spin.
core.desc.CoinSack: At battle start, put {gold.png} 20 in the sack per unused spin, lost if you lose that battle. Each time it holds {gold.png} 300, cash out 300.
core.desc.CrookedFang: After a losing spin, swap one symbol with the center symbol.
core.desc.X2: Pay {gold.png} 200 extra. A win summons double units.
core.desc.MultiEchoMirror: If a losing spin contains 4 or more of the same symbol, gain {essence.png} +1.
core.desc.GreedyTail: If the third spin of a wave loses, reroll {middle.png} up to 2 times.
core.desc.MercContract: Spend {gold.png} 200 to choose 1 of 3 Normal units. Can be used {uses} times.
core.desc.NutrientLeaf: After the first absorption of each wave, the next spin costs 50% less.
core.desc.OldCrown: The selected symbol's appearance chance increases by 5%. You can change it at any time.
core.desc.ResonoscopeChain: After a spin with no winning lines, reveals the symbol that will enter when nudging one random reel.
core.desc.SpareBattery: If a nudge creates no win, regain 1 nudge after the next spin.
core.desc.JokerSeed: Each slot has a 1.5% chance to show a {joker_tooltip.png}.
core.desc.TornNote: Every 6th spin is guaranteed to contain 1 {joker_tooltip.png}.
core.desc.ReboundAxis: After nudging, you may nudge the same reel one additional time.
core.desc.ReverseAxis: When nudging, you can push a reel up as well as down.
core.desc.CycleBell: When nudging, the outgoing symbol moves to the other end of the same line. No new symbols appear.
core.desc.GreedyPearl: Each base symbol nudged off the board grants {gold.png} 50. Up to {gold.png} 100 per wave.
core.desc.RewindClock: After a loss, the next spin costs {gold.png} 25 less.
core.desc.DoubleLedger: On the first win of each spin, the symbols in the winning lines disappear and new symbols fall in from above.
core.desc.EchoLantern: Winning again with the previous winning symbol summons 1 additional unit of that symbol.
core.desc.BlackNote: The first spin of each wave is guaranteed to contain 1 {joker_tooltip.png}.
core.desc.ResonantAnvil: If the winning symbol appears 4 or more times on the slot, summon 1 additional unit of that symbol.
core.desc.LuckyNail: On a loss, lock 2 matching symbols in a row, then stop the last reel.
core.desc.BloodlineSeal: After the first absorption of each wave, the next spin contains 3 symbols of the absorbed unit's class.
core.desc.Wildcard: Each slot has a 2% chance to show a {joker_tooltip.png}. A win with a {joker_tooltip.png} summons 1 additional unit of the winning symbol.
core.desc.GoldenLever: Every 5th spin is a golden spin. A win with a golden symbol raises the summoned unit's rarity by one tier.
core.desc.MagicLamp: On a loss, automatically shifts one reel by one position if it guarantees a win.
core.desc.TricksterCube: Rotates one 2x2 section of the slot grid 90 degrees clockwise.
core.desc.HammerOfFate: During a spin, you can stop each of the 3 reels manually.
core.desc.WitchTorch: On the first win of each wave, rerolls symbols outside winning lines once. Jokers and golden symbols are kept.
core.desc.ChaliceGreed: On a win, banks {gold.png} 100, up to 300. Collect the savings when battle starts. A losing spin forfeits all savings.
core.desc.JokerGrin: On a win with {joker_tooltip.png}, rolls the rarity of 1 unit twice and keeps the higher result.
core.desc.FourLeafClover: Each wave, a clover appears on 1 random slot cell. A win that includes that cell summons 2 additional units of the winning symbol.
core.desc.GoldTooth: The first win of each wave makes the next spin free.
core.desc.EchoShell: Choose 1 equipped core. It gains 1 extra use per wave. You can change your choice after battle.
random_option.effect.14: This unit does not count toward the maximum unit capacity.
skill.desc.shatter_cannon: Fires a powerful cannonball at the enemy with the longest {dist.png}, dealing 200% {atk.png} damage and reducing their {dist.png} to 60 for 4 seconds.
skill.desc.spear_cyclone: Rapidly spins the spear, dealing 25% {atk.png} damage 5 times to up to 3 nearby enemies and knocking away up to 2 basic-attack projectiles.
skill.desc.crushing_counter: Blocks one basic attack with a shield, then slams the spear down to unleash a shockwave in front, dealing 150% {atk.png} damage to each of up to 2 enemies.
skill.desc.collision_drive: Pushes an enemy back with a spear, dealing 130% {atk.png} damage. If they collide with another enemy, both take an additional 60% {atk.png} damage and are stunned for 0.5 seconds.
skill.desc.burst_thrust: Unleashes a shockwave from the spear tip, dealing 120% {atk.png} damage to each of up to 2 enemies in front and launching them into the air for 0.5 seconds.
skill.desc.concussion_bomb: Launches a large bomb, dealing 140% {atk.png} damage to each of up to 3 enemies. Enemies with a debuff are stunned for 0.5 seconds.
skill.desc.timed_keg: Throws an explosive keg at the enemy with the highest HP. After 1.5 seconds, it explodes, dealing 110% {atk.png} damage to the target and up to 2 nearby enemies and knocking them back.
skill.desc.suppressive_round: Shoots the enemy with the longest range, dealing 150% {atk.png} damage and inflicting -35% {dist.png}.
skill.desc.combustion_blast: Launches flames that deal 100% {atk.png} damage and inflict {fire.png} on each of up to 3 enemies. On enemies already affected by {fire.png}, the {fire.png} explodes, dealing an additional 80% {atk.png} damage.
skill.desc.guardian_oath: Roars to grant the Templar and the 2 allies with the lowest {hp.png} a shared shield equal to 40% of the Templar's maximum {hp.png} for 3 seconds.
skill.desc.flame_eruption: Plunges a sword into the ground to erupt flames, dealing 110% {atk.png} damage to each of up to 3 enemies and inflicting {fire.png}.
skill.desc.holy_barrier: Raises a shield to block all damage for 1 second, then grants the ally with the lowest {hp.png} a shield equal to the damage blocked for 3 seconds.
skill.desc.guard_stance: Raises a shield and blocks all damage for 1 second.
skill.desc.counter_stance: Raises a shield, blocks all damage for 1.5 seconds, and reflects damage to attackers.
skill.desc.blade_wave: Launches a blade wave forward, dealing {atk.png} 100% damage to enemies.
skill.desc.storm_blade: Launches a storm blade forward, dealing {atk.png} 130% damage to enemies.
skill.desc.twin_bolt: Fires 2 arrows at up to 2 enemies, each dealing {atk.png} 80% damage.
skill.desc.triple_shot: Fires 3 arrows at up to 3 enemies, each dealing {atk.png} 100% damage.
skill.desc.shackle_arrow: Fires an arrow for 120% {atk.png} damage and applies {spd.png} -35% to the target.
skill.desc.piercing_bullet: Fires a piercing bullet that deals 120% {atk.png} damage to up to 2 enemies.
skill.desc.gale_bow: Rapidly fires 3 arrows, each dealing 85% {atk.png} damage and applying {spd.png} -25% to the enemy hit.
skill.desc.deadly_bullet: Targets the enemy with the highest HP, dealing 200% {atk.png} damage and increasing damage taken by 15%.
skill.desc.precision_shot: Targets an enemy's weakness, dealing {atk.png} 180% damage.
skill.desc.down_strike: Strikes an enemy hard for {atk.png} 140% damage.
skill.desc.bleeding_strike: Slashes an enemy, causing bleeding that deals {atk.png} 20% damage each second for 3 seconds.
skill.desc.blood_price: Consumes 10% HP to deal {atk.png} 200% damage to up to 2 enemies.
skill.desc.blood_rampage: Consumes 15% HP to deal {atk.png} 220% damage to up to 3 enemies ahead.
skill.desc.impact_strike: Strikes an enemy hard for {atk.png} 170% damage and knocks the target back.
skill.desc.savage_slash: Slashes an enemy for {atk.png} 130% damage and inflicts stronger bleeding that deals {atk.png} 30% damage each second. Deals {atk.png} 170% damage if the enemy is already bleeding.
skill.desc.ground_slam: Slams the ground, sending a shockwave that hits up to 2 enemies twice for {atk.png} 60% damage per hit.
skill.desc.crushing_slam: Sends a shockwave that hits up to 2 enemies twice for {atk.png} 70% damage per hit and stuns them for 0.5 seconds.
skill.desc.headshot: Aims at an enemy's weak point, dealing {atk.png} 200% damage and bonus damage if the enemy is at or below {hp.png} 50%.
skill.desc.arcane_orb: Fires an arcane orb that deals {atk.png} 110% area damage to nearby enemies.
skill.desc.binding_bolt: Fires a magic bolt for 125% {atk.png} damage and binds the target for 1 second.
skill.desc.savage_tusk: Summons a boar that fights until defeated. If one already exists, restores its HP.
skill.desc.mountain_roar: Summons a bear that taunts nearby enemies on arrival. If one already exists, restores its HP.
skill.desc.binding_circle: Creates a circle that deals 90% {atk.png} damage to up to 3 enemies and binds them for 1 second.
skill.desc.arcane_core: Creates an arcane core that continuously deals {atk.png} 40% damage to nearby enemies for 2 seconds.
skill.desc.healing_sanctuary: Creates a healing sanctuary that repeatedly restores {hp.png} 7% to the 3 allies with the lowest {hp.png} in range for 3 seconds.
skill.desc.battle_cry: Roars to gain {atk.png} +20% for 3 seconds and applies {atk.png} -15% to up to 3 nearby enemies.
skill.desc.berserk_axe: Throws an axe for 160% {atk.png} damage and gains {atk.png} +25% for 3 seconds.
skill.desc.blood_surge: Drinks wine to build bloodlust, then rapidly strikes the nearest enemy 3 times for {atk.png} 80% damage over 2 seconds.
skill.desc.emperors_roar: Roars to gather strength, then deals {atk.png} 300% damage to an enemy.
skill.desc.piercing_thrust: Thrusts forward, dealing {atk.png} 120% piercing damage to up to 2 enemies.
skill.desc.earth_crush: Slams the ground, dealing {atk.png} 160% damage to each of up to 2 enemies.
skill.desc.guard_thrust: Thrusts for 120% {atk.png} damage and applies {aspd.png} -15% to the target.
skill.desc.heavy_kick: Kicks an enemy for 100% {atk.png} damage and applies {spd.png} -30%.
skill.desc.beast_kick: Kicks 2 enemies for 110% {atk.png} damage each and applies {spd.png} -40%.
skill.desc.guardblade: Strikes up to 2 enemies for 100% {atk.png} damage and takes 20% less damage for 2 seconds.

core.desc.JesterCandle: Each spin, the incoming nudge symbol of one random reel becomes {joker_tooltip.png}.
core.desc.GoldenCrest: When a nudge creates a new win, it does not use up a nudge.

core.desc.OracleHandMirror: While preparing a blast, previews the first incoming symbol on 2 random reels.
core.desc.UpdraftFeather: After a blast, you can fill the empty spaces from below. The remaining symbols are pushed up.
core.desc.SporeShroom: On the next spin of this wave, each slot has a 40% chance to show the type you blasted.
core.desc.ArsonistLighter: When blasting, you can pick 1 more symbol to blow up along with it.
core.desc.PowderKeg: Each wave, a powder keg lands on 1 random cell. With 3+ of its symbol, blast them without a blast charge.
core.desc.BlastCart: Blast 4 or more matching symbols at once to gain {gold.png} 150.
core.desc.Burstberry: With 5 or more matching symbols on the board, blast them all to summon 2 of that unit. Uses no blast charge.
collection_enemy.Eye Crawler.desc: A little cave pest with a very big eye. It scurries up and squeezes through gaps in your defenses.
collection_enemy.Eye Bat.desc: This eye bat has places to be, and your base is next. It slips past the front line on tiny wings.
collection_enemy.Eye Bat.trait: Flies through allies toward the base without attacking them.
collection_enemy.Stinger Bat.desc: A spiteful bat that makes trouble on its way to your base. It leaves poison needles in its wake.
collection_enemy.Stinger Bat.trait: Flies through allies and rushes the base.
collection_enemy.Stinger Bat.skill: Fires poison needles at nearby allies while flying. Targets hit take damage over time from poison.
collection_enemy.Deceiver.desc: A quiet cloak hides an ugly secret. Let the fight drag on and its true face comes out swinging.
collection_enemy.Deceiver.trait: Can dodge attacks at first. Shortly after engaging, it transforms and its attacks grow stronger.
collection_enemy.Cave Brute.desc: A hulking brute built for narrow caves. It lumbers forward and keeps your front line busy with its tough hide.
collection_enemy.Eye Warlock.desc: A cave mage with more than a mean stare. Its dark orbs scatter tightly packed defenses.
collection_enemy.Eye Warlock.skill: Hurls a dark orb that damages and knocks back the target and nearby allies.
collection_enemy.Cave Devourer.desc: A cavern glutton with an appetite to match its jaws. Corner it and even its own side is on the menu.
collection_enemy.Cave Devourer.skill: At low {hp.png}, devours the weakest nearby companion to heal itself. Activates once per battle.
collection_enemy.Observer.desc: A one-eyed sniper with an eye on your back line. It harasses your defenses with beams from afar.
collection_enemy.Observer.trait: Prioritizes ranged allies with long {dist.png}. Its gaze reduces their {spd.png}.
collection_enemy.Beholder.desc: A many-eyed king ruling the caves. Its piercing beams reach far beyond the front line.
collection_enemy.Beholder.trait: Basic attack hits reduce the target's {spd.png}.
collection_enemy.Beholder.skill: Fires a piercing beam at the farthest ally. Allies hit briefly lose {spd.png}.
collection_enemy.Venom Maw.desc: A giant maw that chews anything and spits poison. Neither your front line nor the ground beneath it is safe.
collection_enemy.Venom Maw.skill: Spits poison that leaves a pool dealing damage over time. Swallows and throws a nearby ally, damaging them and nearby allies and stunning the thrown target.
collection_enemy.Venom Maw.trait: Takes less damage while holding a swallowed ally.
collection_enemy.Cave Basilisk.desc: A stone-hued beast guarding the cave depths. Meet its gaze and you will be frozen in place for the next blow.
collection_enemy.Cave Basilisk.skill: Briefly petrifies a nearby ally, preventing actions and dealing more damage to them. Repeatedly hitting the basilisk breaks petrification early.
collection_enemy.Cave Basilisk.trait: Basic attacks sometimes knock back the target and nearby allies.
collection_enemy.Orc Arch Shaman.desc: An old shaman guarding the forest's edge. It casts from afar and spends its last reserves when cornered.
collection_enemy.Orc Arch Shaman.skill: Magic bolts also deal {atk.png} 50% damage nearby. A falling spell strikes a nearby ally for {atk.png} 140% damage.
collection_enemy.Orc Arch Shaman.trait: Once at 50% {hp.png} or lower, strengthens its magic bolts and casts spells more often for 5 s. It then briefly takes more damage.
collection_enemy.Canyon Raptor.desc: A small raptor darting through the canyon. Even muddy ground cannot slow its stride.
collection_enemy.Lizard Guard.desc: A sturdy guard settling into the mud. It is tougher to bring down in a marsh.
collection_enemy.Lizard Guard.trait: Takes less damage while in a marsh.
collection_enemy.Dragonkin Shaman.desc: A shaman heating marshes with dragon blood. Even a quiet pool becomes a searing weapon.
collection_enemy.Dragonkin Shaman.skill: Boils marsh pools to inflict stacking {fire.png} on allies inside. Empty boiling pools fire flaming mud at a nearby ally, dealing damage and inflicting {fire.png}.
collection_enemy.Spine Tyrant.desc: A canyon tyrant clad in sharp spines. The shots you send may come right back.
collection_enemy.Spine Tyrant.skill: Briefly reflects ranged projectiles at their shooter to deal damage. Still takes the original damage itself.
collection_enemy.Razorscale Elder.desc: An old lizard commanding blade-like scales. Watch the scales returning as well as those overhead.
collection_enemy.Razorscale Elder.skill: Drops razor scales across your formation. Each damages the first ally it touches on the way down and again on its return.
skill.desc.razorscale_rain: First activates 5 seconds after combat begins, with a 9-second cooldown. For 4 seconds, one razorscale falls every 0.5 seconds, for a total of 8. The scales draw every living ally once in a random order before reshuffling. 70% land within 2-10 pixels of the target, while 30% miss by 12-24 pixels. Landing X follows the selected unit's real combat position; Y remains within the placement area's vertical band and avoids the Stage 6 rift. Each falling scale deals 50% ATK damage only to the first ally it touches. After the final scale lands, all scales remain embedded for 2 seconds, then return to the Elder. Each returning scale also deals 50% ATK damage only to the first ally it touches.
enemy.skill.razorscale_rain.short: First cast: 5s. Cooldown: 9s. Over 4s, drops 8 scales while drawing every living ally once in random order before reshuffling (70% within 2-10 pixels, 30% miss by 12-24 pixels). Landing X follows the target's real combat position; Y stays within the placement band and avoids the Stage 6 rift. Each scale deals 50% ATK to the first ally hit during its fall and return.
skill.desc.reverse_spine_carapace: Every 7 seconds, raises its spines for 3 seconds. It still takes full damage from ranged projectiles, but each projectile ricochets back to the ally that fired it and deals 50% of its original damage.
enemy.skill.reverse_spine_carapace.short: Every 7 seconds for 3 seconds, ranged projectiles ricochet back to their shooters for 50% of their original damage. The Tyrant still takes full damage.
full_version_hint: See it in the full version!
skill.desc.void_feast: The first time HP falls to 50% or below, devours the lowest-PWR non-boss enemy within 55 range. If none is in range, moves toward the nearest eligible enemy. Restores 4%/6%/8%/10%/12% of max HP based on the victim's PWR. Cannot devour bosses, final bosses, or another Cave Devourer. Activates once per battle.
enemy.skill.void_feast.short: At 50% HP, devours the lowest-PWR enemy and restores 4–12% max HP. (Once per battle)
skill.desc.venom_maw_skills: Toxic Vomit: First casts after 3s, then every 6s. Deals 80% ATK to the ally closest to the base and creates a 4s poison pool at the position locked when fired. Every second, the pool deals 20% ATK poison damage to up to 3 allies within 42 range; overlapping pools cannot damage the same ally more than once on the same tick. Devouring Throw: First casts after 7s, then every 11s. Targets the nearest ally within basic-attack range, preferring the highest-PWR unit when multiple candidates are at a similar distance. If no ally is in range, Venom Maw moves toward the nearest one. Swallows the target for 2s, then spits it toward the largest ally cluster. Venom Maw takes 35% less damage while devouring the target. Deals 80% ATK to the victim and 50% ATK to up to 2 allies within 55 range, stunning the victim for 1s. Can be used twice per battle. If Venom Maw dies while holding a victim, the victim returns to its original position without taking damage.
enemy.skill.venom_maw_skills.short: Toxic Vomit (first 3s/CD 6s): Deals 80% ATK and creates a 4s pool (42 range, 20% ATK per second to up to 3, no overlapping damage). Devouring Throw (first 7s/CD 11s/2 uses): Targets the nearest ally in basic-attack range, prioritizing the highest PWR at similar distances. Swallows for 2s and takes 35% less damage while devouring. Then deals 80% ATK to the victim and 50% ATK to up to 2 allies within 55 range, and stuns the victim for 1s.
skill.desc.cave_basilisk_skills: Cavern Sweep: Deals 100% ATK to the nearest ally. On hit, has a 20% chance to weakly knock back the target and up to 2 nearby allies; this knockback has a 3s internal cooldown. Petrifying Gaze: First casts after 4s, then every 8s, firing a petrifying projectile at the nearest ally within 140 range. On hit, petrifies the target for 10s. The target cannot act and takes 20% more damage from Cave Basilisk. If Cave Basilisk is hit 10 times before the 10s duration ends, petrification ends immediately. The target cannot be petrified again for 3s after it ends.
enemy.skill.cave_basilisk_skills.short: Basic hits have a 20% chance to weakly knock back the target and up to 2 nearby allies (3s internal CD). First casts after 4s, then every 8s, petrifying the nearest ally within 140 range for 10s: +20% Cave Basilisk damage taken. Breaks if Cave Basilisk is hit 10 times, then grants 3s immunity.
skill.desc.lizard_warlord_roar: Every 8s, roars loudly. After the roar, all marsh puddles turn dark for 4s. Allies inside corrupted marsh can still use basic attacks, but cannot start skills. Skills already in progress are not canceled, and leaving the marsh immediately restores skill use.
enemy.skill.lizard_warlord_roar.short: Every 8s, roars. After the roar, all marsh puddles turn dark for 4s. Allies inside can basic attack, but cannot start skills. Already-running skills continue, and leaving the marsh restores skill use immediately.
skill.desc.dragonkin_boiling_marsh: Every 7s, selects 2 marsh puddles and turns them into boiling marsh for 4s. Allies inside a boiling marsh gain 1 stack of Dragonblood Burn. Dragonblood Burn lasts 4s and deals 20% of Dragonkin Shaman ATK every second. It stacks up to 3 times, and any new application refreshes all stack durations to 4s. The burn remains after leaving the marsh. If no ally is inside a puddle when it starts boiling, that puddle fires Flame Mud once at the nearest ally, dealing 80% ATK damage and applying 1 Dragonblood Burn stack.
enemy.skill.dragonkin_boiling_marsh.shor: Every 7s, turns 2 marsh puddles into boiling marsh for 4s. Allies entering gain 1 Dragonblood Burn stack. Dragonblood Burn lasts 4s, deals 20% ATK per second, stacks up to 3, and refreshes all stacks to 4s on new application. Empty puddles fire Flame Mud at the nearest ally for 80% ATK and 1 stack.
synergy.forest.condition: Triggers the first time each Forest unit falls to 50% {hp.png} or below
synergy.empire.condition: Applied to all Empire units at the start of battle
synergy.outlaw.condition: Applies when attacking an enemy at 40% {hp.png} or below

skill.desc.wasteland_piper_melody: First activates 5 seconds after battle starts. Cooldown: 12 seconds. The Piper plays the flute for 1 second, then charms the current highest-PWR ally for 3 seconds.
enemy.skill.wasteland_piper_melody.short: First cast: 5 seconds after battle starts. Cooldown: 12 seconds. Plays the flute for 1 second, then charms the current highest-PWR ally for 3 seconds.
skill.desc.demon_drive: Every 5 seconds, slams the greatsword down and pushes up to 2 nearest allied demons within 35 range in each demon's direction of travel.
enemy.skill.demon_drive.short: Every 5 seconds, slams the greatsword down and pushes up to 2 nearest allied demons within 35 range in each demon's direction of travel.
skill.desc.hell_warden_blackout: First casts 3 seconds after battle starts, then every 6 seconds. For 0.8 seconds, all player units cannot start new basic attacks or skills. Movement, actions already in progress, and launched projectiles continue normally. Ends immediately if the Hell Warden dies. At 0.25 seconds after death, it explodes for 75 damage to all player units within 50 range and inflicts a non-stacking burn that deals 8 damage per second for 4 seconds.
enemy.skill.hell_warden_blackout.short: First cast: 3s. Cooldown: 6s. Blocks new player attacks and skills for 0.8s. At 0.25s after death, explodes within 50 range for 75 damage and burns for 8 damage per second for 4s.
skill.desc.hell_witch_soul_abduction: Whenever a player unit dies while the Hell Witch is alive, she briefly performs her charm animation and summons 1 Imp at the unit's death location.
enemy.skill.hell_witch_soul_abduction.sh: Whenever a player unit dies, briefly performs a charm animation and summons 1 Imp at the death location.
skill.desc.hell_enforcer_execution: Every 6 seconds, leaps to and grabs the farthest player unit within 100 range, then strikes it 6 times over 0.9 seconds. Each hit deals 40% ATK damage, and the grabbed target cannot move. Ends immediately if the target dies; remains ready if no target is in range.
enemy.skill.hell_enforcer_execution.shor: Cooldown: 6s. Grabs the farthest player unit within 100 range and strikes 6 times over 0.9s for 40% ATK damage per hit. The target cannot move during the barrage.
skill.desc.demon_lord_dominion: Whenever an allied demon dies, grows up to 5 stacks. Each stack grants +8% size, +7% ATK, and +5% max HP, and also increases current HP by the max HP gained. At 3 stacks, basic attacks splash for 40% ATK to up to 2 player units within 35 range of the primary target. Splash damage rises to 50% at 4 stacks and 60% at 5 stacks.
enemy.skill.demon_lord_dominion.short: On allied demon death, gains up to 5 stacks of +8% size, +7% ATK, and +5% max HP. From 3 stacks, basic attacks splash to up to 2 units within 35 range for 40% ATK, rising to 50%/60% at 4/5 stacks.
skill.desc.dark_lord_fear_strike: First activates 4 seconds after battle starts, then every 6 seconds. The Dark Lord's sword slowly turns purple before he slams it down. On frame 15 of attack2, a purple shockwave spreads across all placeable ground, dealing 80% ATK damage to every living player unit. Units at 50% current HP or less after taking damage are feared for 1.8 seconds.
enemy.skill.dark_lord_fear_strike.short: First cast: 4s. Cooldown: 6s. On attack2 frame 15, strikes all placeable ground for 80% ATK damage to every living player unit. Units at 50% current HP or less after taking damage are feared for 1.8s.
skill.desc.doom_dragon_burn: First cast: 4s. Cooldown: 7s. Erupts in flame at the current attack target within basic-attack range, dealing 140% ATK to the primary target and 70% ATK to up to 3 nearby units. Damaged units burn for 25% of the Doom Dragon's ATK every second for 4 seconds. A burning unit immediately removes this burn when it uses a skill. Remains ready without a current target in range.
enemy.skill.doom_dragon_burn.short: First cast: 4s. Cooldown: 7s. Deals 140% ATK to the current target in range and 70% ATK to up to 3 nearby units. Damaged units burn for 25% ATK each second for 4s. Using a skill immediately removes the burn from that unit.
skill.desc.skeleton_dragon_soul_backflow: First cast: 3s. Cooldown: 6s. When a player unit is within basic-attack range, conjures green flame on the unit with the highest ATK, dealing 120% ATK to the primary target and 50% ATK to up to 2 nearby units. For 2.5s, the primary target's basic attacks deal no damage and instead heal the Skeleton Dragon for 60% of the damage they would have dealt, capped at 25% of the Dragon's max HP per cast. Skill and imprint damage apply normally. The skill remains ready when no target is in range.
enemy.skill.skeleton_dragon_soul_backflo: First cast: 3s. Cooldown: 6s. Deals 120% ATK to the highest-ATK unit in range and 50% ATK to up to 2 nearby units. For 2.5s, the primary target's basic attacks heal the Dragon for 60% of their prevented damage, capped at 25% max HP per cast. Skills and imprints deal damage normally.
skill.desc.rift_shuriken: Every 5 seconds, throws a shuriken at 1 player unit within 140 range in the opposite lane, dealing 70% ATK damage. If there is no target in the opposite lane, the skill remains ready and is not used.
enemy.skill.rift_shuriken.short: Every 5 seconds, deals 70% ATK damage to 1 player unit within 140 range in the opposite lane. Does not activate without a valid target.
skill.desc.starlight_guard: First activates after 3 seconds, then every 6 seconds assumes a guarding stance for 2.5 seconds. While guarding, completely blocks every ranged attack arriving from the opposite lane. Attacks from the same lane deal damage normally.
enemy.skill.starlight_guard.short: First activates after 3s, then every 6s blocks every ranged attack from the opposite lane for 2.5s. Same-lane attacks deal damage normally.
skill.desc.gravity_arrow: First activates after 4 seconds, then every 7 seconds fires a powerful cosmic arrow at the farthest ranged player unit across both lanes. The hit unit's range is reduced to 55 for 3 seconds.
enemy.skill.gravity_arrow.short: First activates after 4s, then every 7s attacks the farthest ranged player unit across both lanes and reduces its range to 55 for 3s.
skill.desc.formation_breaker: Every 7 seconds, slams the player unit it is currently attacking with its shield, launching the target to the back of that lane and dealing 100% ATK damage.
enemy.skill.formation_breaker.short: Every 7s, launches its current target to the back of that lane and deals 100% ATK damage.
skill.desc.gravity_leap: Immediately after its first basic attack after combat begins, if the opposite lane has fewer player units than its current lane, it leaps across the central rift into the opposite lane. It then fights normally in that lane. Activates once per combat.
enemy.skill.gravity_leap.short: After its first basic attack, leaps across the central rift if the opposite lane has fewer player units than its current lane, then fights there normally. Once per combat.
skill.desc.spatial_exchange: First activates after 5 seconds, then every 8 seconds plants its staff into the ground, randomly selecting one player unit from each lane and swapping their positions. If either lane has no valid target, the skill remains ready.
enemy.skill.spatial_exchange.short: First activates after 5s, then every 8s randomly selects one player unit from each lane and swaps their positions.
skill.desc.crescent_flurry: First activates after 4 seconds, then every 8 seconds spins for 2 seconds. While spinning, blocks all melee basic attacks and deflects ranged basic attacks in a straight line toward a random player unit in the opposite lane for 40% of the original damage. If that lane has no target, the projectile is deflected and disappears. Skill attacks deal damage normally.
enemy.skill.crescent_flurry.short: First activates after 4s, then every 8s for 2s. Blocks melee basics and deflects ranged basics in a straight line to a random unit in the opposite lane for 40% damage. Skill attacks are unaffected.
skill.desc.crystal_barrier: Every 8 seconds, raises its shield and creates a massive 1,100 HP crystal wall in front of itself. While the wall lives, the Guard and enemies behind it cannot be attacked; the wall must be destroyed first. The wall destroys itself after 6 seconds. When destroyed, it launches crystal shards at up to 2 player units within 35 range, each dealing 60% ATK damage.
enemy.skill.crystal_barrier.short: Every 8s, creates a 1,100 HP crystal wall ahead. It protects the Guard and enemies behind it and destroys itself after 6s. On destruction, it deals 60% ATK to up to 2 units within 35 range.
skill.desc.starlight_theft: Basic attacks have a 25% chance to knock the target back. This effect has a 2.5-second internal cooldown. First activates after 5 seconds, then every 10 seconds selects one highest-star player unit, choosing randomly among ties. On projectile hit, steals one star for 4 seconds and transforms the target into its previous-star unit form and performance, then restores the original star and unit. Only units with 2 or more stars can be targeted.
enemy.skill.starlight_theft.short: Basic attacks have a 25% chance to knock the target back (2.5s internal cooldown). First activates after 5s, then every 10s randomly selects one of the highest-star units. On hit, steals one star and transforms it into its previous-star unit for 4s. Only 2-star or higher units are valid targets.
skill.desc.hammer_rain: Does not use basic attacks. First activates after 3 seconds, then every 5 seconds drops 8 small hammers in sequence at random battlefield positions over about 3 seconds. On Stage 6, four hammers are distributed above the rift and four below it, and none land in the rift. Each hammer deals 90% ATK damage.
enemy.skill.hammer_rain.short: Does not use basic attacks. After 3s, then every 5s, drops 8 hammers at random battlefield positions over about 3s. On Stage 6, four land above the rift and four below it. Each deals 90% ATK damage.
skill.desc.twin_star_barrier: One lord appears in each lane, sharing 16,000 HP. After 6s, then every 6s, the lords alternate a 3s shield, starting with the upper lord. Only the shielding lord takes 65% less damage; the other takes normal damage.
enemy.skill.twin_star_barrier.short: One lord appears in each lane, sharing 16,000 HP. After 6s, then every 6s, the lords alternate a 3s shield, starting with the upper lord. Only the shielding lord takes 65% less damage; the other takes normal damage.
skill.desc.star_scales: Every 7s, compares living allies in the upper and lower lanes. Rises into the air, then deals 120% ATK damage to up to 3 allies in the more populated lane. If counts are equal, the Judge takes 20% more damage for 3s instead. Only ranged units can attack the Judge while airborne.
enemy.skill.star_scales.short: Every 7s, deals 120% ATK damage to up to 3 allies in the lane with more living allies. Equal counts: the Judge takes 20% more damage for 3s. Only ranged units can attack it while airborne.

collection_enemy.Clawed Demon.desc: It closes the gap with a sudden clawed leap. A front line alone cannot keep it at bay.
collection_enemy.Clawed Demon.skill: Leaps at a nearby ally for {atk.png} 150% damage.
collection_enemy.Clawed Demon.trait: Explodes on death, damaging nearby allies.
collection_enemy.Cosmic Sovereign.desc: It hovers over the rift and presses down on the whole battlefield. Only the foremost ally can act under its pressure.
collection_enemy.Cosmic Sovereign.skill: For 3 s, stops all allies from moving, attacking or using skills except the ally at the very front.
collection_enemy.Crescent Raider.skill: Briefly blocks melee basic attacks and reflects ranged basic attacks at allies in the opposite lane. Cannot block skills.
collection_enemy.Crescent Raider.desc: It spins its weapon to block and reflect attacks. Basic attacks alone struggle to break through.
collection_enemy.Crystal Guard.skill: Protects itself and enemies behind it with a crystal wall. When the wall breaks, shards damage nearby allies.
collection_enemy.Crystal Guard.desc: It raises a crystal wall to shelter itself and enemies behind it. Beware of shards when the wall breaks.
collection_enemy.Dark Lord.skill: Attacks all allies. Those at 50% {hp.png} or less after the hit are briefly feared.
collection_enemy.Dark Lord.desc: Its crushing strikes shake the entire battlefield. Allies with low health may flee in fear.
collection_enemy.Demon Lord.skill: Fellow demons' deaths make it grow and increase {atk.png} and maximum {hp.png}. As it grows stronger, basic attacks also damage nearby allies.
collection_enemy.Demon Lord.desc: It draws power from the deaths of fellow demons. Each fallen demon makes it a greater threat.
collection_enemy.Hell Enforcer.skill: Grabs the farthest ally and attacks repeatedly. The target cannot move until the combo ends.
collection_enemy.Hell Enforcer.trait: Explodes on death, damaging nearby allies.
collection_enemy.Hell Enforcer.desc: It snatches distant allies and batters them relentlessly. The back line offers little safety.
collection_enemy.Hell Witch.skill: Summons 1 imp where an ally dies.
collection_enemy.Hell Witch.desc: It calls new demons from the places where allies fall. Your losses become enemy reinforcements.
collection_enemy.High Demon.skill: Pushes up to 2 nearby fellow demons forward.
collection_enemy.High Demon.desc: Its greatsword drives fellow demons forward. Even a slow pack advances quickly beside it.
collection_enemy.Lizard Brute.desc: A giant lizard at home in the mud. A heavy blow can send your front line into a marsh.
collection_enemy.Lizard Brute.skill: Periodically empowers its next basic attack to knock an ally into a nearby marsh. Hits harder if no marsh is nearby.
collection_enemy.Lizard Shaman.desc: A shaman that makes trouble underfoot. It can create a marsh right beneath a group of allies.
collection_enemy.Lizard Shaman.skill: Creates temporary marsh pools where allies are clustered.
collection_enemy.Lizard Warlord.desc: An imposing warlord commanding the marsh line. Its roar darkens the mud beneath your feet.
collection_enemy.Lizard Warlord.skill: Its roar briefly darkens all marshes. Allies inside cannot start skills; leaving restores their use. Skills already underway continue.
collection_enemy.Skeleton Dragon.skill: Attacks the ally with the highest {atk.png} and nearby allies. The main target's basic attacks briefly heal the dragon; skills and imprints still deal normal damage.
collection_enemy.Skeleton Dragon.desc: It turns your strongest attacks into its own life force. Beware of basic attacks under Soul Backflow.
collection_enemy.Space Assassin.skill: Throws a shuriken at an ally in the opposite lane, dealing {atk.png} 70% damage.
collection_enemy.Space Assassin.desc: An assassin that throws shuriken across the rift. Being in the other lane does not keep you safe.
collection_enemy.Space Cavalry.skill: Once per battle, moves to the opposite lane if it has fewer allies.
collection_enemy.Space Cavalry.desc: It crosses the rift toward the lane with fewer allies. Watch both defenses.
collection_enemy.Space Guardian.skill: Briefly blocks ranged attacks from the opposite lane. Attacks from the same lane still get through.
collection_enemy.Space Guardian.desc: Its starlight shield stops shots from across the rift. The lane you attack from matters.
collection_enemy.Space Hunter.skill: Attacks the farthest ranged ally, briefly reducing their {dist.png}.
collection_enemy.Space Hunter.desc: Its gravity arrows seek distant shooters. Reduced range can unsettle even a safe back line.
collection_enemy.Space Knight.skill: Sends its current attack target to the rear of their lane, dealing damage.
collection_enemy.Space Knight.desc: Its heavy blow sends the front line flying to the rear. A single strike can break your formation.
collection_enemy.Space Wizard.skill: Randomly selects 1 ally from each lane and swaps their positions.
collection_enemy.Space Wizard.desc: It swaps allies between the upper and lower lanes. A careful formation can unravel in an instant.
collection_enemy.Star Judge.skill: Attacks up to 3 allies in the lane with more allies. Briefly becomes vulnerable if both lanes have equal numbers. Only ranged attacks can hit it while airborne.
collection_enemy.Star Judge.desc: It weighs the number of allies in each lane. A crowded lane faces a harsher judgment.
collection_enemy.Star Priestess.skill: Drops hammers across the battlefield to damage allies instead of making basic attacks.
collection_enemy.Star Priestess.desc: It rains hammers across the battlefield. Neither lane has a completely safe position.
collection_enemy.Starlight Paladin.skill: Basic attacks can knock the target back. Steals 1 star from a promoted ally with the highest star rank, briefly reverting them to the previous promotion.
collection_enemy.Starlight Paladin.desc: It steals stars and the power of promotion from your allies. It targets those with the highest star rank first.
collection_enemy.Twin Star Lords.skill: The two lords share {hp.png} and take turns raising shields that greatly reduce incoming damage.
collection_enemy.Twin Star Lords.desc: Twin lords sharing a single life. Watch their alternating shields to choose which lane to attack.
collection_enemy.Axe Lizard.desc: A lizard pounding the front line with its axe. Crude, but hard to drive back.
collection_enemy.Bat Matron.desc: A sturdy mother with a brood to command. Block her path and her young still fly on to your base.
collection_enemy.Bat Matron.skill: Calls Eye Bats to attack the base. At reduced {hp.png}, calls them again if all its young have fallen.
collection_enemy.Blood Assassin.desc: An assassin following the scent of blood. Even a guarded line cannot hide a wounded ally.
collection_enemy.Blood Assassin.trait: Its first attack targets the ally with the lowest remaining {hp.png} and deals extra damage.
collection_enemy.Bloodtail.desc: A wasteland predator with a blood-red tail. Every sting helps it recover.
collection_enemy.Bloodtail.skill: Stabs a nearby ally with its tail stinger and restores its own {hp.png}.
collection_enemy.Cackle Shaman.desc: A shaman cackling curses from the rear. That doll over your head is no toy.
collection_enemy.Cackle Shaman.skill: Attaches a curse doll to the ally with the highest combat power. It explodes shortly after, dealing damage and blinding them.
collection_enemy.Crimson Raptor.desc: A crimson raptor that keeps going without its rider. It kicks up mud and bites at the front line again.
collection_enemy.Doom Dragon.skill: Deals {atk.png} 140% damage and {fire.png} to the target and nearby allies. Using a skill removes the burn.
collection_enemy.Doom Dragon.desc: A massive dragon that burns through your defenses. Using a skill clears the burn clinging to an ally.
collection_enemy.Dunefang.desc: A saber-toothed beast swinging blades in the dust. Its slashes reach beyond the front line.
collection_enemy.Dunefang.skill: Sends a piercing slash forward, cutting through allies in its path.
collection_enemy.Dust Hyena.desc: A lean hunter racing through the sand. Any gap in the front line is an invitation.
collection_enemy.Ember Imp.desc: An imp that hurls embers from afar. Small flames become dangerous when they pile up.
collection_enemy.Ember Imp.trait: Explodes on death, damaging nearby allies.
collection_enemy.Firebreather.desc: A lizard holding embers in its mouth. Huddle together and you may share its fiery breath.
collection_enemy.Firebreather.skill: Breathes fire at nearby allies in front of it.
collection_enemy.Firebreather.trait: Attacks inflict {fire.png}. Further hits refresh its duration without stacking.
collection_enemy.Gazer.desc: A watchful eye on your front line. Its sharp stare saps the strength of your strongest fighters.
collection_enemy.Gazer.skill: Gazes at the ally with the highest {atk.png} within range, briefly reducing their {atk.png}.
collection_enemy.Gnoll Archer.desc: A gnoll drawing its bow behind the front line. Its arrows arrive before its laughter.
collection_enemy.Gnoll Berserker.desc: A gnoll whose laughter grows fiercer with its wounds. Keep your distance when cornering it.
collection_enemy.Gnoll Berserker.skill: At low {hp.png}, strikes nearby allies hard and knocks them back. Activates once per battle.
collection_enemy.Greatsword Rider.desc: A rider wielding a greatsword atop a crimson raptor. Defeating the rider does not end the fight.
collection_enemy.Greatsword Rider.skill: Once per battle, entering a marsh triggers a forward leap that strikes an ally near its landing point.
collection_enemy.Greatsword Rider.trait: When defeated, its crimson raptor remains and keeps fighting.
collection_enemy.Hell Warden.skill: Briefly blocks all allies from using basic attacks and skills. Explodes on death, leaving {fire.png} nearby.
collection_enemy.Hell Warden.desc: It passes through your defenses while locking down allied actions. Death leaves an explosion and burning wounds.
collection_enemy.Imp.desc: A small demon that slips quickly through the ranks. Even in death, it threatens nearby allies.
collection_enemy.Imp.trait: Explodes on death, damaging nearby allies.
collection_enemy.Lizard Hunter.desc: A clever hunter with a firm grip on its spear. Neither distance nor close quarters offer safety.
collection_enemy.Lizard Hunter.trait: Stabs nearby allies and throws spears at distant ones. Throws deal extra damage to allies in marshes.
collection_enemy.Pack Chief.desc: A hefty chief leading the pack. Its orders give nearby claws a sharper edge.
collection_enemy.Pack Chief.skill: Empowers the next basic attack of itself and nearby hyena and gnoll companions.
collection_enemy.Rascal Imp.desc: Its mischievous shots pierce through to allies behind the target. Keep your ranks from lining up.
collection_enemy.Rascal Imp.trait: Basic attacks pierce up to 2 allies. Explodes on death, damaging nearby allies.
collection_enemy.Shield Gnoll.desc: A gnoll tucked behind a hefty shield. It would rather hold the line than lead the charge.
collection_enemy.Shield Gnoll.trait: Its shield reduces damage from early hits. The protection wears off after several blocks.
collection_enemy.Succubus.desc: A demon that disrupts formations with her whip and charm. Even your strongest ally can be drawn to her.
collection_enemy.Succubus.skill: Charms the strongest ally and draws them toward itself. The charmed ally cannot attack or use skills.
collection_enemy.Succubus.trait: Whip strikes knock the basic attack target back. Explodes on death, damaging nearby allies.
collection_enemy.Wasteland Piper.desc: A strangely carefree piper in the wasteland. Will your allies stay loyal after hearing its tune?
collection_enemy.Wasteland Piper.skill: Plays its flute to briefly charm the ally with the highest combat power. The charmed ally attacks its own side.
collection_enemy.Wasteland Warrior.desc: A hardy warrior shaped by the wasteland. Watch its teeth as closely as its weapon.
collection_enemy.Wasteland Warrior.skill: Periodically turns its next basic attack into a powerful bite.
